page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head top left, page number top right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Nec disfonum est jus divi-num, quod exigit, ut pro fratribus vitam exponamus. Utque proximum, sicut nosmet ipsos diligamus. Deut. 6. v. 5. Matth. 22. v. 37. Marc. 10. v. 31. Luc. 10. v. 27. Ordin. crim. Carol. 5. art. 142. & 150. Gomes. tom. 3. Var. resol. c. 2. Gail. 2. obs. 110. n. 19. Bocer. tract. de Duell. Speck-han quaest. jur. cent. 3. class. 2. quaest. 9. Dissentiunt, Bartol. Ja-son. in l. 3. D. de just. & jur. Vaud. & Bull. locis citatis.

Non tamen praecise quispi-am ad hoc obstringitur, si id sine proprię vitæ dispendio fieri non possit. Arg. l. 50. D. de Reg. jur. l. 125. in fin. D. de Verbor. si-gnif. In pari quippe causa, amor nostri ipsius, amori proxi-mi est præferendus. l. 7. §. Quid si autem latitare. D. quibus ex causa in poss. eat. l. 6. §. ult. D. de Re mi-lit.

page.notes: Printed "disfonum" read as "dissonum" (long s and double s). "fi-gnif." read as "si-gnif." because the long s matches the regular s elsewhere on the page. The numeral "50" is read as printed with a small gap. Otherwise the page is clear.
